Title: Regarding Daring the Dawn and ruling for Day Operation

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, "Eric J. Liu" <el...@EMAIL.CSUN.EDU> wrote:
> There is a current (Feb98) ruling that states:
>
> "* If an event (like successful Return to Innocence [AH]
> with Day Operation) both burns and torporizes a vampire,
> the controller decides whether the vampire will go into
> torpor before being burned. [RTR 960708]"
>
> This obviously has application to the situation where the vampire playing
> RtI has Fame on her. Does this also apply to Daring the Dawn which
> inflicts unpreventable aggravated damage, causing a similar effect?

Yes, since Daring the Dawn's damage takes place after the action,
like Day Operation's effect.
